project-id.description: Project identifier from config or environment.

source.description: How and where this change was triggered.

kind.description: Initiation method. 'interactive-prompt' for agent terminal/chat (most common). 'job-run' for automated jobs. 'workflow-stage' for job stages. 'manual-script' for CLI scripts. 'release-finalization' for archive steps.

session-id.description: Conversation session ID if part of a named session. Null for ad-hoc.

job-id.description: Job ID if part of a structured job workflow. Null for ad-hoc.

packet-id.description: Packet/stage ID if produced by a specific packet within a job. A packet is a discrete task sent to an LLM provider. Null when not in a job.

prompt-id.description: Prompt ID if triggered by a specific prompt. Null for general work.

target-ref.description: Short kebab-case slug describing the work (e.g. 'windows-log-rollover-fix').

review-id.description: Review ID if produced/approved as part of a review. Null when no review performed.

change-class.description: Change category. 'feature'=new functionality, 'code-fix'=bug fix, 'refactor'=restructure without behavior change, 'docs'=documentation, 'tests'=test changes, 'config'=config changes, 'release'=release process, 'audit'=audit/tracking, 'workflow'=CI/CD.

files.description: Relative file paths changed from project root.

technical-summary.description: Detailed 'what and why' — the audit trail.

user-summary-candidate.description: Concise changelog-style summary for user-facing output.

status.description: 'unreleased' when recording. The archive step stamps 'released'.

release-id.description: Stamped by archive_current_ledger when status transitions to released.

git-commits.description: Git commit SHAs from post-commit hook. Append-only. Do not set manually.
